family: F=c(W)G(S,X)+(1-c(W))H(S,Y), disjoint W,S,X,Y; c a Boolean indicator
domain: All 16 two-bit sign controllers; all 16^2 pairs of two-bit shared-only branches; all 16^2 pairs of branches on one shared and one private bit each. Scalar p=0..16/16, x,y=-8..8/8.
case_count: 8192 Boolean roots; 4913 scalar triples. Each root includes compatible-reference checks with uniform and index-weighted seed laws.
arithmetic: Integer Walsh transform, Fraction probabilities, exact rational prime-log vectors; sign by denominator clearing and integer product comparison. Analytic proof handles continuum.
pilot: 16 Boolean roots per domain and 51 scalar triples; under 60 seconds
